get_config: load a Hydra DictConfig from a YAML config file with optional overrides
setup_config: setup random seed, habitat plugins, and wandb logger from a DictConfig
fix_config: recursively resolve Hydra config interpolations to prevent multi-process resolution issues
save_data: save a list of rollout result dicts to a CSV file at a given path
rollout_print: print LLM planner responses to console with color-coded agent prefixes
